name: Subscription renewing
description: The advance notice before a subscription renews: the date, what renews, the price, and how to change or cancel while it is still free to do so.

origin.note: Design: calendar notice — the date opens the page in a band of its own, serif heading, price stated once, cancel offered at the same weight as change.

subject: Your {{ plan_name }} plan renews on {{ renews_on }}
preheader: The terms, the amount and the way out, while changing your mind is still free.

plan_name.description: The plan as the customer knows it, not the internal price-book name.

renews_on.description: The renewal date, set at display size and repeated in the sentence about changing your mind. Keep it short-form — this is the largest text in the email and a full date with a year wraps on a phone.

body.description: One paragraph under the heading. Its job is to say that no action is required, so that the actions below read as options rather than demands.
body.default: This is the notice we send before every renewal. You do not need to do anything — the plan continues and the card on file is charged on the day. The details below are what will be charged, so that nothing on your statement is a surprise.

terms_rows.description: The renewal terms as `label`/`value` pairs: plan, price, period, payment method. Money is formatted here at the call site because decimal separators and currency placement are not universal, and the price appears in this table only — stating it twice in one email is how a reader ends up unsure which number is real.

manage_url.description: Where the plan itself is changed — a different destination from the cancel path, because a customer who wants a smaller plan should not have to walk through a cancellation flow to find one.

cancel_url.description: The direct cancel path. Given equal visual weight on purpose: a renewal notice that buries the exit is the thing regulators and customers both read as a trap. Leave it empty only where cancellation genuinely is not self-serve.

cancel_label.description: Label for the cancel action. Say the word — "cancel" — rather than a euphemism.

statement_note.description: The descriptor the charge appears under on a bank statement, and any tax note. It is here so that an unrecognised line on a statement does not become a chargeback.
statement_note.example: The charge appears on your statement as ACME SOFTWARE.
